python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data points: t=1 (May) through t=4 (August)
t = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4])
y = np.array([25678, 16506, 34850, 264156])

# Fit a 2nd-degree polynomial (quadratic)
coefficients = np.polyfit(t, y, 2)
a, b, c = coefficients

print(f"Quadratic regression: y = {a:.2f}t^2 + {b:.2f}t + {c:.2f}")
print(f"Coefficients: a={a}, b={b}, c={c}")

# Project value for September 1939 (t=5)
t_september = 5
y_september = np.polyval(coefficients, t_september)
print(f"\nProjected September 1939 value (t=5): {y_september:.2f}")

# Germany invaded Poland on September 1, 1939 (day 1)
invasion_day = 1

# Divide projected value by day number
result = y_september / invasion_day
print(f"\nInvasion day: {invasion_day}")
print(f"Result (projected value / day): {result:.2f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest whole number: {round(result)}")
EOF
